key_concepts: Contact force is a force between objects that are touching
Applied force is a push or pull exerted on an object
Normal or support force acts on an object resting on a surface
Tension force is transmitted through a flexible material when pulled
Friction force opposes motion between surfaces in contact
Contact forces are present in daily activities such as pushing chairs, carrying bags, and
An unbalanced force causes an object to move in the direction of the applied force
Balanced equal and opposite forces do not change an object's motion
Heavier objects require more force to move because of increased friction
